name: registry_shared_contacts
source: Enhetsregisteret bulk file enheter.csv.gz (telefon, mobil, forretningsadresse, postadresse), NLOD 2.0
description: Registry phone numbers filed by two or more organisation numbers, and street addresses shared by sister organisations. The website identity gate never counts them as corroboration and never publishes such a phone. Also every filed website domain with its filers (chain/group domains), names of organisation numbers sharing a discovered host, and Norwegian place names (which never align a site's brand on their own).
